newsitem.title: UK: Manders warns on annual profits.
newsitem.headline: Manders warns on annual profits.

text.p: Britain's Manders Plc said on Wednesday pretax profits for the year to December 1997 will be "significantly below market expectations".
The company, which makes speciality coating and printing inks, said that margins were being eroded by higher material prices and continued pressure on its selling prices.
with two thirds of group sales in foreign currencies, the translation effect of the strong pound was also hurting profitability, it added.
Manders said, however, competitive pressure on prices was easing and profitability should improve in the second half.
Shares in the company fell on the back of the announcement to stand 15p lower at 115p in pre-market trade.
